data.name: CheckTooWet1
data.value: How wet the soil is a few centimetres down, with a finger or a meter.
data.comment: One thing to look at for a cause in What could it be? It says what to check, never what to do.

data.name: CheckTooWet2
data.value: Whether the pot drains and isn't standing in water.

data.name: CheckTooWet3
data.value: Slide the plant out and look at the roots: healthy ones are firm and light, rotting ones are brown or black, soft, and may smell.

data.name: CheckTooDry1
data.value: Whether the soil is dry all the way down and the pot feels light.

data.name: CheckTooDry2
data.value: Whether water runs straight through without wetting the soil, which happens when it has dried hard.

data.name: CheckTooLittleLight1
data.value: How far it is from the window and which way the window faces.

data.name: CheckTooLittleLight2
data.value: Whether new growth leans towards the light or has longer gaps between leaves than the old.

data.name: CheckTooMuchSun1
data.value: Whether the marks are on the leaves facing the window and on the top of the leaves.

data.name: CheckTooMuchSun2
data.value: Whether they appeared within days of a move or a sunny spell.

data.name: CheckRecentChange1
data.value: Whether it started after the change.

data.name: CheckRecentChange2
data.value: Whether the newest leaves and the growing point still look healthy, which often means it is settling in.

data.name: CheckCold1
data.value: Whether it stands by a door, a window that is opened, cold glass at night, or a heater or vent that blows on it.

data.name: CheckDryAir1
data.value: Whether the brown is only at the tips and edges and the rest of the leaf is fine.

data.name: CheckDryAir2
data.value: Whether it stands near a radiator or a vent.

data.name: CheckSalts1
data.value: Whether there is a white crust on the soil or the rim of the pot.

data.name: CheckSalts2
data.value: What water it gets and how often it has been fed.

data.name: CheckHungry1
data.value: When it was last fed or given fresh soil.

data.name: CheckHungry2
data.value: Whether the yellowing is even across the older leaves rather than in spots.

data.name: CheckRootsFillPot1
data.value: Whether roots come out of the holes at the bottom or circle the inside of the pot.

data.name: CheckRootsFillPot2
data.value: Whether water runs straight through.

data.name: CheckPests1
data.value: The undersides of the leaves and where they meet the stem, with a magnifier if you have one.

data.name: CheckPests2
data.value: Fine webbing, a sticky shine, white fluff or small bumps that scrape off.

data.name: CheckLeafSpot1
data.value: Whether the spots are dark with a yellow ring, or look wet.

data.name: CheckLeafSpot2
data.value: Whether they spread to new leaves over a week.

data.name: CheckAgeing1
data.value: Whether it is one or two of the oldest leaves at a time and the new growth is healthy. Then it is usually the plant letting go of old leaves.

data.name: CheckRest1
data.value: Whether it does this around the same time each year.

data.name: CheckRest2
data.value: For a corm, tuber or rhizome, whether it is still firm.

data.name: GeneralSoil

data.comment: One of the general checks shown when the answers do not point to one cause.

data.name: GeneralLeaves
